lines.text: Joseph, a good and righteous Council member from Arimathea, went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in linen and laid it in a rock tomb, and the women from Galilee watched and prepared spices.
Very early on the first day of the week, the women found the stone still in place and two men in radiant apparel beside them.
The two men said Jesus had risen, and the women told the Pharisees, naming Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James.

wrong_details.true: the Eleven and all the others

lines.text: The apostles did not believe the women, but Peter ran to the tomb, saw only the linen cloths, and went away wondering.
